name: BWild Grain Free All Breeds Adult

variants.name: Lamb, Potatoes & Peas 12 kg
variants.about_this_item: Monge Natural SuperPremium Grain Free Formula All Breeds Adult Dog Lamb with Potatoes and Peas is a complete and balanced pet food for adult dogs. Formulated for the well-being of your all breed dogs thanks to the selection of alternative sources of carbohydrates not derivate from cereals, like peas and potatoes. The recipe is enri ched by a complex of prebiotics in mannan-oligosaccharides (MOS) and xylo-oligosac charide (XOS), which keep the intestinal wellness. The formulation support the joints through the inclusion of glucosamine and chondroitin sulphate. The omega-3 fatty acids to support skin and coat, and give shine to the hair. It contains spiruline and yucca schidigera, for intestinal aroma control. Suitable for All breeds dogs. No added dyes and artificial preservatives.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Lamb meat (dried 38% and fresh 10%), potatoes (14%), animal fat (14%) (chicken fat purified 99.5%), potato protein, brewers yeast, peas (4%), dried beet pulp, hydrolyzed animal proteins (3%), mannan-oligosaccharides (MOS 1%), xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.3%), yucca schidigera (0.3%), spiruline (0.3%), glucosamine (0.057%), chondroitin sulphate (0.04%), milk protein powder.

Analytical constituents: Crude Protein: 28,00%, Crude Fibre: 2,2%, Crude fat:16,50%, Crude ash: 7,50%, n-3 fatty acids: 0,2%, n-6 fatty acids: 3,4%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES / kg: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate): 22,700 IU, Vitamin D3: 1,600 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate): 500 mg, selenium (sodium selenite 0.44 mg): 0.2 mg, manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 93.7 mg): 31 mg, zinc (zinc oxide 196 mg): 150 mg, copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 48 mg): 12 mg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 333 mg): 106 mg, iodine (calcium iodate anhydrous 2.6 mg): 1.7 mg, L-Carnitine 100 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Tocopherol extracts from vegetable oils.
variants.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes (see table) may be split into 2 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and activity level of the animal. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times. When this product replaces another type of feed and/or diet it is recommended to introduce it gradually over a period of at least 1 week. Dog food only, not suitable for human consumption.
